step_outputs.3:
Posted: https://github.com/Max-Garcia-06/self-healing-integrations/issues/1#issuecomment-5080281028

**Status:** Research Complete. All versions verified against PyPI JSON API today, not recalled.

Two findings outrank rest:

**H1** — all 5 declared deps already at latest published version (httpx 0.28.1, pydantic 2.13.4, pytest 9.1.1, fastapi 0.140.0, uvicorn 0.51.0). No upgrade decision exists.

**H2** — `httpx` has **no total-request deadline**. All four timeout categories (connect/read/write/pool) are network-inactivity timers. `httpx.Timeout(3.0)` sets each independently — one request can exceed 3s wall clock without tripping. Makes gap #2 a capability question: per-attempt is free, total budget needs hand-rolled monotonic deadline. R5 must pick before adapter prompt finalized.

Blockers resolved with citations:

| # | Resolution |
|---|---|
| B3 | OpenAPI 3.1 spec: absent `servers` **declares** url `/`, not omits it. Snapshot cannot supply base URL. `src/config/shipfast.py` load-bearing, now cited not inferred |
| R4/gap 7 | `X-Shipper-Id` = client-level default, headers merge with per-request. Zero-prompt-diff holds **only if** prompt says "configured vendor headers" generically. Wording constraint on Step 4+ |
| R4 rule | httpx does not raise on 4xx/5xx. R4 is explicit `status_code` branching. `HTTPTransport(retries=)` retries only ConnectError/ConnectTimeout — can never violate R4, but 429 retry fully hand-rolled |
| F2 | `pythonpath = ["."]` (not `["src"]` — dotted path is `src.types.shipping`). Two lines, no build backend. `norecursedirs` closes F8 |
| R5 exc | `ProviderTimeout` wraps `httpx.TimeoutException` base — catching `ReadTimeout` alone misses connect-phase hang, exactly what R5 exists for |

Real trap found for R6: redaction `logging.Filter` on root logger is insufficient — child records reach ancestor *handlers* without ancestor *logger* filters running. Attach to handlers.

Dep recommendation: `respx` 0.23.1 over `pytest-httpx` 0.36.2 — latter hard-pins `httpx==0.28.*`, and project about surviving upstream churn should not pin exact minor of the churning library. Plus `pydantic-settings` 2.14.2 (`SecretStr` masks repr, covers key/account half of R6 without any logging infra).

Verified `src/types` vs stdlib `types` shadowing directly — no runtime shadow, stdlib wins from `sys.modules`. Only a hazard if `src/` itself goes on path.

Nothing written outside `/tmp`. `mock/` referenced read-only; B1 ownership still undecided.
